text:
incident-bot: Paging: high p95 latency on api/redwood-gen in us-west-2 (alert: gen_api_high_p95). Incident link: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2364123456>

sara (oncall): Ack. Joining bridge in 2m. Observed spike coincides with a deploy? Anyone on the deploy? :eyes:

mike (sre): I didn't see a deployment. Telemetry shows a sudden increase in KV cache evictions and CPU on pool-dedicated-4.

elena (prodeng): We're seeing ~18% error increase for customers on dedicated tier. puneet, do we need customer comms?

puneet (customer-ops): Yes — two enterprise customers on dedicated pools reported errors. I'll draft a targeted note if we confirm root cause.

sara (oncall): Initial mitigation: set fallback routing to model-variant v1-small and scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes. Implementing now.

incident-bot: Action: auto-scale triggered for pool-dedicated-4 -> +2 GPUs. (autoscaler)

jordan (eng-platform): I pushed a quick revert of the kernel-selection tweak to canary groups. Rolling back across dedicated pools in 1m.

mike (sre): Latency p95 dropping after revert and scale. Errors trending down.

sara (oncall): Good. Passing to post-ops: can we schedule a postmortem? Who owns root cause analysis?

elena (prodeng): I'll own RCA. Suggested postmortem time: tomorrow 10:30 PT. I'll add action items: (1) root cause and repro, (2) alert rule tuning, (3) paging thresholds, (4) customer comms draft.

puneet (customer-ops): I'll prepare the two customer updates and sync with legal if needed.

jordan (eng-platform): For alert tuning, propose: change gen_api_high_p95 to 5m evaluation window and exclude canary traffic; add suppression if autoscale is in-flight. Snippet:
```
alert: gen_api_high_p95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.6
for: 5m
labels: {severity="page"}
annotations: {runbook="https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gen_api_high_p95"}
```

sara (oncall): Action items assigned: RCA - elena, Alert tuning & playbook - jordan/mike, Customer notes - puneet, Follow-ups & postmortem doc - sara. I'll create the postmortem doc and link here.

mike (sre): Also recommend creating a synthetic test hitting KV-heavy code paths to catch regressions before canary promotions.

elena (prodeng): Agreed. We'll track the synthetic test + rollout gating in the postmortem and link to the kernel change PRs.

sara (oncall): Thanks team. Closing the live incident. I'll announce safe-to-close in #incidents once the postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
